os_version: macOS 26.5.2 (25F84), Apple Silicon, live user session (not headless)

stack_detection.method: NSWorkspace bundle identifier + AX tree responds with real content on first query
stack_detection.signature: bundle com.apple.TextEdit; AXUIElementCreateApplication(pid) returns full window tree (45 nodes) in 41 ms

channel_setup: Grant Accessibility (TCC) to the host process (Terminal.app) — one System Settings toggle by the user; pyobjc ApplicationServices AX* calls. Apple Events consent (separate TCC dialog) needed only for the AppleScript convenience used to create/close the throwaway document, not for AX itself.

t1_read_text.detail: Known sentence typed into a throwaway rich-text doc recovered character-exact via AXValue of the AXTextArea: accents (éàçœ), em-dash, and astral-plane emoji 🦊 all intact. Text arrives as real strings (no glyph IDs). Note: AX ranges count UTF-16 units (emoji = 2), Python counts code points — off-by-one trap for range math.

t2_enumerate.detail: 40+ interactive elements with exact AXFrame rects: text area, scroll area + 2 scrollbars, ruler + 15 markers, format bar (4 style AXCheckBoxes with AXDescription 'gras'/italique/…, 2 color wells, font/typeface popups, size combo, 4 alignment checkboxes, list + line-spacing menus), 3 traffic-light buttons. Cross-checked against a window screenshot: counts, labels and positions match 1:1.

t3_live_value.detail: Typed ' T3-XKQ-42-macos' via synthetic CGEvents; AXValue of the text area reflects the live value immediately; single-attribute read <0.1 ms.

t4_living_screen.detail: TextEdit has no self-updating region; living-screen is covered in the clock/CDP cells. Idle half measured here: polling AXValue 1×/s for 5 s while idle = 0 diff bytes (idle costs nothing, vs 1 screenshot/frame for pixels).

t5_blind_action.detail: Blind clicks from AXFrame-derived coords land exactly: caret jumped to text offset 1 (click near line start) and 87 (near line end), verified via AXSelectedTextRange — no screenshot used for aiming. Two instructive failures en route: (1) window was moved by the human mid-run → clicks at stale coords missed (TOCTOU race; mitigation: re-read frame immediately before acting + verify it unchanged after); (2) a modal sheet swallowed clicks on the format bar (see t6). AXPress actions (e.g. dismissing sheets) are coordinate-free and immune to both.

t6_pictorial.detail: PNG pasted into the rich-text doc is DECLARED, not silently absorbed: AXValue grows by one U+FFFC object-replacement char and an AXImage child node appears under the text area with the image's exact on-screen rect (120×95 at its true position, matches screenshot) → targeted pixel crop is possible. Side-effect worth knowing: the paste opened a 'Convert to RTFD?' modal sheet.

measurements.notes: view_bytes = compact-JSON serialization of the full window AX tree (45 nodes, all attributes). Screenshot side: this 586×488-logical window is 1172×976 px at Retina 2× → 1526 tokens (w·h/750); at logical resolution it would be 381 tokens — on a SMALL window a downscaled screenshot can be cheaper than the FULL AX dump; but an agent rarely needs the full dump (interactive-elements + text subset ≈ 2.5 KB ≈ 630 tokens), the AX view is queryable per-attribute (T3 re-read <0.1 ms, ~100 bytes) and idle costs 0. Full-screen baseline this machine: 1512×982 logical ≈ 1980 tokens (7920 at 2×). diff_bytes_per_interaction: re-reading just the changed AXValue after typing 16 chars ≈ 64 B vs re-screenshot.

runtime_verification.method: Window screenshot vs AX view: element counts/labels/positions compared (T2); pasted-image AXImage rect vs its visible position (T6); text content vs screen (T1). Plus negative-space check: the 'invisible modal' hypothesis was tested and resolved — sheets do NOT appear in AXWindows but ARE exposed via AXFocusedWindow (role AXSheet) and as children of their parent window; the CGWindow (pixel) layer lists them as separate windows.
runtime_verification.agreement: 100% on all cross-checks; no silent divergence found. The one candidate (format-bar B button unresponsive, AXValue stuck at 0) was explained: a modal sheet was blocking input, and the AX view did declare it (AXFocusedWindow) — explicit once you query the right attribute.

permissions_required: Accessibility (TCC) for host process — user toggle in System Settings
Screen Recording (TCC) — only for the verification screenshots, not for AX itself
Apple Events consent per scripted app (only for AppleScript document setup/teardown)
